use_case_summary: SageVeil is a mid-market product analytics SaaS. They need semantic search across release notes, product docs, and customer-support threads. Primary flows: search & retrieval in product UI, reranking search results, and offline nightly embedding jobs to keep index fresh.
requirements_summary:
- Query latency target: <100ms end-to-end for top-10 retrieval (not including network overhead)
- Nightly batch: ~100k documents -> need cost-efficient bulk embedding and vector DB bulk upsert
- Integrations: Pinecone today (managed), possible Milvus/Mongo vector store later
- Security: SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS, ability to pin EU residency for certain datasets
- Routing/fallback: prefer hosted model during POC, fallback to smaller/quantized model when capacity constrained
poc_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks) - Hosted API POC: ingest 50k docs, measure embed cost, throughput, and per-embed latency; validate Pinecone connector; produce perf + cost report
Phase 2 (1 week) - Tune batching/quantization recommendations (Redwood Optimize) and re-run embeddings on sampled 100k set
Phase 3 (2 weeks) - Dedicated trial: reserved capacity quotes, run low-latency retrieval scenarios, confirm SLA and traceability
Decision gate - Evaluate TCO, latency SLOs, and security checklist before procurement
pricing_expectations: Mid-market budget; expecting Hosted to be attractive for first 6 months. Looking for committed monthly price if Dedicated lowers unit cost by 30%+ for high-volume embedding jobs.
